market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower. RBA rate hike expectations (36) and oil shock (41) create headwinds, partially offset by global AI/tech rally (38). ^AXJO to test support; ^AORD may outperform on rate sensitivity. Jetstar action (25) adds near-term volatility to transport.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Iron ore structural downside (70), China rebalancing (50), and Australian fiscal deterioration (49, 51) cap cyclicals. Gold, rare earths, and healthcare offer relative strength. AI capex cycle supports tech but debt froth (3) warrants selectivity. Housing correction (71) may deepen before stabilising.
